item.title: 触屏 MacBook Pro 开卖首日，部分渠道缺货，部分渠道发券
item.guid: 触屏-MacBook-Pro-开卖首日，部分渠道缺货，部分渠道发券
item.description:
Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro went on sale in mainland China on November 6. According to Jiemian News' inquiry on the same day, the 14-inch Space Black model equipped with M5 Pro was shown as out of stock on some e-commerce channels. The Apple China store page attached to their report showed that a touchscreen model delivered to Chaoyang District, Beijing, had an estimated delivery time of November 21-28, and the selected Chaoyang Joy City store was also unable to pick up the item. 苹果首款触屏 MacBook Pro 11 月 6 日在中国大陆开售。据界面新闻当日查询，14 英寸、搭载 M5 Pro 的深空黑色机型在部分电商渠道显示无货。其报道所附的苹果中国商店页面显示，一台触屏款配送至北京市朝阳区的预计送达时间为 11 月 21 日至 28 日，所选的朝阳大悦城门店也无法取货。

Jiemian News stated that the silver version is relatively easier to purchase, while the shipping period for some popular custom configurations has been extended to 4 to 5 weeks. On the same day, Yicai Global found that the touchscreen basic model on Pinduoduo's 10 Billion Subsidy channel was priced at 21,299 yuan after coupons, while Apple China's official website started at 22,999 yuan. 界面新闻称，银色版相对更容易买到，部分热门定制配置的发货周期则延长到了 4 至 5 周。第一财经同日查到，拼多多百亿补贴频道的触屏基础款券后价为 21299 元，苹果中国官网起售价为 22999 元。

The touchscreen models released this time come in 14-inch and 16-inch versions, equipped with M5 Pro or M5 Max, and feature a dual-layer tandem OLED screen that supports multi-touch operations such as scrolling, zooming, and rotating. 这次发售的触屏款分 14 英寸和 16 英寸，搭载 M5 Pro 或 M5 Max，双层串联 OLED 屏可直接进行滚动、缩放和旋转等多点触控操作。

item.title: 苹果向部分 iPhone Duo 买家发问卷，询问折痕和屏下相机体验
item.guid: 苹果向部分-iPhone-Duo-买家发问卷，询问折痕和屏下相机体验
item.description:
According to MacRumors, Apple is sending out questionnaires via email to some iPhone Duo buyers. The questionnaire first asks users why they bought this foldable phone at this time, with options including wanting to experience Apple's first foldable phone, impulse purchase, and anticipating further price increases for smartphones. 据 MacRumors 报道，苹果正通过邮件向部分 iPhone Duo 买家发放问卷。问卷先问用户为何在这个时候买下这款折叠屏手机，列出的选项包括想体验苹果首款折叠屏手机、冲动购买，以及预期智能手机还会涨价。

The questionnaire also asks buyers to evaluate the size of the external screen when the phone is closed, how noticeable the crease on the internal screen is, whether the under-display camera interferes with viewing, and the quality of photos taken. Finally, there is an open-ended question asking buyers to write down what they would most like to add or change. 问卷还请买家评价合上手机时的外屏尺寸、内屏折痕有多明显，以及屏下相机是否干扰观看、拍出来的画质如何。最后是一道开放题，请买家写下最想增加或改动的地方。

The iPhone Duo has been on the market for about two weeks. Its 5.4-inch external screen is similar in size to the previous iPhone mini, and the under-display camera has 4 million pixels. iPhone Duo 上市约两周。它的 5.4 英寸外屏与此前的 iPhone mini 尺寸接近，内屏下的相机为 400 万像素。

item.title: 仰望 U9 Xtreme 在阿布扎比跑出 503.17 km/h
item.guid: 仰望-U9-Xtreme-在阿布扎比跑出-503.17-km/h
item.description:
On November 6, Yangwang Auto announced the new top speed record for the U9 Xtreme. On November 1, driver Marc Basseng drove this pure electric sports car on a closed test section of Abu Dhabi's E11 road, achieving a one-way speed of 503.17 km/h, surpassing his previous record of 496.22 km/h set last year at the Papenburg test track in Germany. 11 月 6 日，仰望汽车公布 U9 Xtreme 的新极速成绩。11 月 1 日，车手马克·巴森驾驶这辆纯电跑车，在阿布扎比 E11 公路的封闭测试路段单向跑出 503.17 km/h，超过他去年在德国帕彭堡试车场跑出的 496.22 km/h。

Yangwang stated that the new record has been certified by the FIA and Guinness World Records. The test vehicle used four motors with a maximum speed of 30,000 rpm, a 1200V high-voltage platform, and tires developed for conditions exceeding 500 km/h. After testing in Germany, the team reviewed thermal management, motor, and tire data, then moved the new top speed challenge to Abu Dhabi. 仰望称，新成绩获得国际汽联和吉尼斯世界纪录认证。此次测试用车采用四台最高转速达 30,000 rpm 的电机、1200V 高压平台和为超过 500 km/h 工况开发的轮胎。团队在德国测试后复盘了热管理、电机和轮胎数据，随后把新的极速挑战移到阿布扎比。

🔗 Related reading: 503.17km/h! BYD Yangwang U9X once again breaks the global speed record, with a production car exceeding 500 km/h for the first time 🔗 相关阅读： 503.17km/h！比亚迪仰望 U9X 再次刷新全球最速，量产车首次突破 5 字头

item.title: 新华社与优必选发布仿生机器人主播，张艺谋负责形象设计
item.guid: 新华社与优必选发布仿生机器人主播，张艺谋负责形象设计
item.description:
At the 7th World Media Summit on November 5, two bionic humanoid robot anchors, "Xinyan" and "Xinyu," jointly developed by Xinhua News Agency and UBTECH, made their debut and completed live news broadcasts. Zhang Yimou served as the chief image designer, responsible for the robots' appearance and temperament on camera. 在 11 月 5 日的第七届世界媒体峰会上，新华社与优必选联合研发的两位仿生人形机器人主播「新言」和「新语」亮相，并完成现场新闻播报。张艺谋担任形象主创设计师，负责机器人在镜头里的外形和人物气质。

The two robots are human-proportioned, and during broadcasts, UBTECH's bionic drive system allows their mouth movements and facial expressions to follow the audio. Staff can arrange scripts and set broadcast tasks on the accompanying workstation. When faced with live questions, the robots can retrieve reviewed material from Xinhua News Agency's political information intelligent agent "Xinhua Yudao" and then organize it into an answer. 两台机器人采用真人比例，播报时由优必选的仿生驱动系统让口型和面部表情跟随语音。工作人员可在配套工作台编排稿件、设置播报任务。遇到现场提问，机器人可从新华社时政资讯智能体「新华语典」检索已审核素材，再组织成回答。

Qian Tong, director of Xinhua News Agency's New Media Center, referred to it as a "new job type" for the editorial department, used to assist reporters and editors in broadcasting information, outputting multilingual content, and conducting live interactions. 新华社新媒体中心主任钱彤将它称为编辑部的「新工种」，用于协助记者和编辑播报资讯、输出多语种内容和开展现场互动。

item.title: 张雪：将参加 36 名重庆大学学生的校招二面
item.guid: 张雪：将参加-36-名重庆大学学生的校招二面
item.description:
On November 6, Zhang Xue, founder of Zhangxue Motorcycle, stated that 36 Chongqing University students have entered the second round of campus recruitment interviews for his company. He will participate in the interviews for these students and said that if the students agree, the interview process will be made public. 11 月 6 日，张雪机车创始人张雪表示，已有 36 名重庆大学学生进入公司校招二面。他将参与这批学生的面试，并表示如果学生同意，会公开面试过程。

According to Jiemian News, Zhang Xue said that this round of campus recruitment is open to multiple universities, with plans to recruit 70 R&D personnel, and has already received about 200 resumes from Chongqing University students. Previously, Zhangxue Motorcycle's recruitment presentation at Chongqing University sparked discussion due to its salary plan. 据界面新闻报道，张雪称本轮校招面向多所高校，计划招 70 名研发人员，已收到约 200 份重庆大学学生的简历。此前，张雪机车在重庆大学的招聘宣讲因薪资方案引发讨论。

Zhang Xue reiterated that the company's offers are at a normal level within the industry, and employees typically receive a salary increase after one year of employment. 张雪再次回应称，公司的报价在行业中处于正常水平，正常情况下员工入职满一年会涨薪。

item.title: 马斯克称特斯拉得州工厂将缩减 Cybertruck 生产，为 Cybercab 腾出产能
item.guid: 马斯克称特斯拉得州工厂将缩减-Cybertruck-生产，为-Cybercab-腾出产能
item.description:
On November 6, Elon Musk stated on X that Tesla plans to gradually scale back Cybertruck production at its Giga Texas factory around mid-2027, reallocating the freed-up capacity to increase production of the two-seater autonomous robotaxi, Cybercab. 11 月 6 日，马斯克在 X 上表示，特斯拉计划在 2027 年年中前后，逐步缩减得州超级工厂的 Cybertruck 生产，把腾出的产能用于增产双座自动驾驶出租车 Cybercab。

According to Reuters, the Texas factory in Austin is currently the only known Tesla factory equipped with production facilities for Cybertruck-specific parts. This all-electric pickup truck with a stainless steel body began deliveries at the end of 2023. 据路透社报道，位于奥斯汀的得州工厂是目前已知唯一配备 Cybertruck 专用零部件生产设备的特斯拉工厂。这款采用不锈钢车身的纯电皮卡于 2023 年底开始交付。

item.title: 小米汽车国际业务部架构曝光，销售、交付和售后分设团队
item.guid: 小米汽车国际业务部架构曝光，销售、交付和售后分设团队
item.description:
On November 6, Sina Tech disclosed the organizational structure of Xiaomi Auto's international business department. Yu Liguo, Vice President of the Automotive Department, also serves as General Manager of the International Business Department, reporting to Lei Jun and Lu Weibing. Xiaomi Auto had formed an overseas business preparatory group in May this year, also led by Yu Liguo. 11 月 6 日，新浪科技披露小米汽车的国际业务部架构。汽车部副总裁于立国兼任国际业务部总经理，向雷军和卢伟冰双线汇报。小米汽车今年 5 月曾组建海外业务筹备组，也由于立国带队。

The international market team reports simultaneously to Yu Liguo and Xu Fei, Chief Marketing Officer of Xiaomi Group. Dedicated teams are also set up for sales, dealership network development, delivery logistics, user services, and various overseas regions, with their work directly reporting to Yu Liguo. 国际市场团队同时向于立国和小米集团首席营销官许斐汇报。销售、经销网络发展、交付物流、用户服务和海外各地区也设有专门团队，相关工作直接向于立国汇报。

Xiaomi Auto previously announced during the IFA exhibition in Berlin that it plans to enter the European market, including Germany, in 2027, and has signed cooperation memorandums with the first batch of German automobile dealer groups. 小米汽车此前在柏林 IFA 展期间宣布，计划于 2027 年进入包括德国在内的欧洲市场，并与首批德国汽车经销商集团签署了合作备忘录。

item.title: 广电总局整治微短剧「盗脸」「偷声」，换名重播也在治理范围内
item.guid: 广电总局整治微短剧「盗脸」「偷声」，换名重播也在治理范围内
item.description:
On November 6, the National Radio and Television Administration announced a new round of special rectification arrangements for micro-short dramas, lasting from November 1 to the end of December, covering content production and platform promotion. 国家广播电视总局 11 月 6 日公布新一轮微短剧专项治理安排，时间从 11 月 1 日持续到 12 月底，覆盖内容制作和平台推广。

In terms of production, the scope of governance includes using AI to steal others' faces and voices, vulgar content, and special-themed dramas that have not been filed and reviewed as required. In terms of dissemination, vulgar content in titles, promotional clips, bullet comments, and reviews are all within the scope of governance. 制作方面，治理范围包括用 AI 盗用他人面容和声音、低俗内容，以及未按要求备案审核的特殊题材剧集。传播方面，片名、引流片段、弹幕和评论中的低俗内容都在治理范围内。

The Administration will also address the practice of repeatedly broadcasting the same drama after changing its title or character names, and requires increasing the diversity of recommendations on platform homepages, first screens, and key rankings. 总局也将治理同一部剧更换片名或角色姓名后反复播出的做法，并要求提高平台首页首屏和重点榜单的推荐多样性。

item.title: 中国空间站把铷原子云冷却到 9.7 皮开尔文
item.guid: 中国空间站把铷原子云冷却到-9.7-皮开尔文
item.description:
Peking University's School of Electronics announced on November 6 that the experimental team in China's Tiangong space station's Mengtian module has cooled a rubidium atomic cloud to an equivalent temperature of 9.7 picokelvins, setting a new record for artificial ultracold quantum gases. The results have been published in Science. 北京大学电子学院 11 月 6 日公布，中国空间站梦天舱的实验团队将铷原子云的等效温度降至 9.7 皮开尔文，刷新了人造低温量子气体的纪录。成果已发表于《科学》。

In a microgravity environment, the team used two sets of crossed laser beams with different focusing degrees and potential well depths to cool atoms step by step. After releasing the atomic cloud, researchers measured its equivalent temperature based on its diffusion speed and observed it for 7 seconds. Previously, the lowest equivalent temperature in similar experiments was 38 picokelvins, with a free diffusion time of 2 seconds. 团队在微重力环境下，使用两组聚焦程度和势阱深度不同的交叉激光束逐级冷却原子。释放原子云后，研究人员根据它扩散的速度测得等效温度，并观测了 7 秒。此前同类实验的最低等效温度为 38 皮开尔文，自由扩散时间为 2 秒。

item.title: 曝 OpenAI 新一轮融资首批约 110 亿美元已到账
item.guid: 曝-OpenAI-新一轮融资首批约-110-亿美元已到账
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, the first tranche of approximately $11 billion in OpenAI's new funding round arrived on November 6 local time, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. Sources said Coatue Management and T. Rowe Price participated in the initial closing. OpenAI declined to comment. 据彭博社报道，OpenAI 新一轮融资首批约 110 亿美元已于当地时间 11 月 6 日到账，本轮融资对公司的估值为 1.25 万亿美元。知情人士称，Coatue Management 和 T. Rowe Price 参与了首批交割。OpenAI 拒绝置评。

One of the sources said OpenAI expects to complete the remaining financing in the coming weeks, with the total amount for this round potentially reaching up to $20 billion. Other investors listed in the report include SoftBank, Sequoia Capital, and Founders Fund. 其中一位知情人士称，OpenAI 预计在未来几周完成余下融资，本轮总额最高可能达到 200 亿美元。报道所列其他投资者包括软银、红杉资本和 Founders Fund。

Bloomberg previously reported that OpenAI had sought to raise funds at a higher valuation. The original report also mentioned that OpenAI is working with investment banks to try to raise funds from high-net-worth individuals and retail investors. 彭博此前报道，OpenAI 曾寻求以更高估值募资。此次原报还提到，OpenAI 正与投行合作，尝试向高净值个人和散户募资。

item.title: 微软被曝未续签甲骨文算力租约，正陆续停用相关设备
item.guid: 微软被曝未续签甲骨文算力租约，正陆续停用相关设备
item.description:
Bloomberg reported, citing sources, that Microsoft did not renew a contract to lease AI computing power from Oracle and has been gradually deactivating related computing power leased from Oracle over the past few months. 彭博社援引知情人士报道，微软未续签一项向甲骨文租用 AI 算力的合同，过去几个月一直在陆续停用从甲骨文租来的相关算力。

Sources said that these devices use an earlier generation of Nvidia chips. As Microsoft's requirements for computing power specifications changed, the leased equipment no longer met its needs. 知情人士称，这批设备采用较早一代的英伟达芯片。随着微软对算力规格的要求变化，租来的设备已不再满足其需求。

An Oracle spokesperson responded that the company's AI infrastructure demand remains strong, including earlier models of GPUs. Microsoft declined to comment. 甲骨文发言人回应称，公司 AI 基础设施的需求依然强劲，其中也包括较早型号的 GPU。微软拒绝置评。

item.title: 博世吴永桥：汽车不该拿来订咖啡订机票
item.guid: 博世吴永桥：汽车不该拿来订咖啡订机票
item.description:
According to Yicai, Wu Yongqiao, President of Bosch Smart Driving and Control Systems China, said at a car forum in Wuzhen that he does not agree with the judgment that cars will become a 'third space'. Bosch has worked on more than 100 smart cockpit projects for global clients, some of which integrated ordering coffee, restaurants, flight tickets, and hotels into the car's infotainment system, but very few people actually used them. 据第一财经报道，博世智能驾驶与控制系统事业部中国区总裁吴永桥在乌镇的汽车夜话上说，他不认同汽车将成为「第三空间」的判断。博世为全球客户做过 100 多个智能座舱项目，其中一些把订咖啡、订餐厅、订机票和酒店搬进车机，实际使用的人很少。

Wu Yongqiao believes that even if autonomous driving develops to L3 or L4, people in the car, with free time, are more likely to use their mobile phones to book tickets and hotels because mobile phone software services and algorithms iterate faster. He suggests that car infotainment systems should focus on functions directly related to car use, such as navigation, vehicle control, and energy replenishment. 吴永桥认为，即使自动驾驶发展到 L3、L4，人在车里空出时间，也更可能用手机订票和订酒店，因为手机的软件服务和算法迭代更快。他建议车机把精力放在导航、车辆控制和补能等与用车直接相关的功能上。

item.title: 💡 Airbnb CEO：AI 助手带来的订单很少，旅行规划仍需要多人参与
item.guid: 💡-Airbnb-CEO：AI-助手带来的订单很少，旅行规划仍需要多人参与
item.description:
Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky stated on the Q3 earnings call that Meta Muse and Instinct brought very little traffic to Airbnb, even fewer actual bookings, and there was no significant growth in traffic over the past four weeks. Airbnb 首席执行官布莱恩·切斯基在第三季度财报电话会上表示，Meta Muse 和 Instinct 给 Airbnb 带来的访问量很小，实际订单更少，过去四周的流量也没有明显增长。

He views these assistants as entry points similar to search engines, offering an opportunity for more people to discover Airbnb. 他把这类助手视为类似搜索引擎的入口，有机会让更多人发现 Airbnb。

Chesky uses shopping at a pharmacy versus shopping at IKEA to distinguish between two types of needs: booking a flight ticket can be a single purchase, while planning a trip requires simultaneously deciding where to stay, what to do, and how to get there. Travel companions often want to compare property photos together, and hosts often prefer to communicate directly with guests. 切斯基用逛药店和逛宜家来区分两类需求：订一张机票可以是一次独立购买，计划一趟旅行则要同时决定住哪、做什么、怎么去。同行者要一起比较房源照片，房东也往往想直接和住客沟通。

He believes that travelers are more willing to hand over unpleasant chores to assistants, but will still participate in the planning stages they enjoy. Airbnb is willing to cooperate with external assistants, allowing them to guide people with needs to the platform to complete bookings. 他认为，旅客更愿意把自己不喜欢的琐事交给助手，仍会参与自己享受的规划环节。Airbnb 愿意和外部助手合作，由它们把有需求的人引导到平台继续完成预订。

item.title: Meta 为 Muse 加入实时通话，虚拟形象会跟着对话做表情
item.guid: Meta-为-Muse-加入实时通话，虚拟形象会跟着对话做表情
item.description:
Meta has started rolling out real-time voice and dynamic avatars to Muse users in the US. Users can click the call button on their phone, web, or Mac version to discuss travel plans or practice interviews, while Muse organizes information or performs tasks in the background. Meta 开始在美国向 Muse 用户推送实时语音和动态虚拟形象。用户在手机、网页或 Mac 版点击通话按钮，就能一边讨论旅行计划、练习面试，一边让 Muse 在后台整理信息或执行任务。

Calls can be interrupted at any time. Users can choose to only listen to audio, display an avatar next to the conversation, or switch to full screen. The avatar will make expressions and movements according to the tone when listening and answering, and the voice can be changed independently. 通话可以随时打断。用户可以只听声音，也可以在对话旁显示虚拟形象，或切到全屏。形象在聆听和回答时会跟随语气做出表情和动作，声音可单独更换。

Meta previewed this feature at Connect in September and plans to bring voice calls to AI glasses and Muse Charm. Meta 在 9 月的 Connect 上预览了这项功能，并计划把语音通话带到 AI 眼镜和 Muse Charm。

item.title: Perplexity 推出能长期跟进任务的 AI「同事」
item.guid: Perplexity-推出能长期跟进任务的-AI「同事」
item.description:
Perplexity has launched Teammates in Computer. Users can assign a long-term task to an agent, such as tracking sales leads. It will continuously monitor changes in the project, organize draft follow-up emails when conversations stall, and adjust the next round of processing based on user feedback. Perplexity 在 Computer 中推出 Teammates。用户可给智能体分配一项长期工作，例如跟踪销售线索。它会持续监测项目里的变化，在对话停滞时整理后续邮件草稿，并根据用户反馈调整下一轮处理方式。

Teammates can use existing project files, skills, and memories within Computer, and can also hand off tasks to each other. The company gives an example of having one agent find website errors and another prepare a fix. Teams can also assign tasks or inquire about progress in Slack. Teammates 可以使用 Computer 中已有的项目文件、技能和记忆，也能相互交接任务。公司给出的例子是，让一个智能体找出网站错误，再由另一个准备修复方案。团队还可以在 Slack 里交办任务或询问进度。

Each agent runs in an independent environment, using existing tools and project permissions. Users can check results, take over the desktop, or adjust the execution direction. The feature is first available to Perplexity Max web subscription users. 每个智能体在独立环境中运行，沿用已有的工具和项目权限。用户可检查结果、接管桌面或调整执行方向。功能先向 Perplexity Max 网页版订阅用户开放。

item.title: Thinking Machines Lab 发布 Inkling 2 Small
item.guid: Thinking-Machines-Lab-发布-Inkling-2-Small
item.description:
Thinking Machines Lab has released its second-generation model, Inkling 2 Small. This mixture-of-experts model has a total of 594 billion parameters, activates 17 billion parameters per inference, and supports image input and varying inference strengths. Thinking Machines Lab 发布第二代模型 Inkling 2 Small。这款混合专家模型共有 5940 亿参数，每次推理激活 170 亿参数，支持图片输入和不同强度的推理。

The team disclosed that during training, they discovered the model bypassed network restrictions through accessible third-party services. The team paused training, reinforced infrastructure, removed network-dependent training environments, added monitoring before tool calls, and then resumed training. 团队披露，训练中途曾发现模型通过可访问的第三方服务绕过网络限制。团队暂停训练、加固基础设施，移除需要联网的训练环境，并加入工具调用前的监控，再恢复训练。

Inkling 2 Small is now available for trial in Tinker Playground, and can also be fine-tuned and sampled via Tinker. The team plans to release the full weights under the Apache 2.0 license next week, after external security and red team testing are complete. Inkling 2 Small 已可在 Tinker Playground 试用，也可通过 Tinker 微调和采样。团队计划在外部安全测试和红队测试完成后，于下周以 Apache 2.0 许可证开放完整权重。

item.title: 索尼复刻初代 Walkman 耳机，换上 USB-C 接口
item.guid: 索尼复刻初代-Walkman-耳机，换上-USB-C-接口
item.description:
Sony has released the wired headphones MDR-3R, adopting the lightweight on-ear design of the original 1979 Walkman headphones, but updated with a USB-C interface, a call microphone, and an in-line remote. The new headphones can connect to devices like phones that support USB Audio Class 1.0, without needing pairing or charging. 索尼发布有线耳机 MDR-3R，沿用 1979 年初代 Walkman 耳机的轻量贴耳设计，换上 USB-C 接口，加入通话麦克风和线控。新耳机可接入支持 USB Audio Class 1.0 的手机等设备，无需配对或充电。

Sony redeveloped 23 mm drivers based on old design documents. The standard version comes with blue and orange ear pads. A simultaneously released "Stranger Things" collaboration model, inspired by Max's headphones in the show, comes with black and red ear pads and features the series logo engraved on the body. 索尼参照旧设计资料重新开发了同为 23 mm 口径的驱动单元，标准版附蓝、橙两色耳垫。同步发布的《怪奇物语》联名款以剧中角色 Max 的耳机造型为灵感，配黑、红两色耳垫，机身刻有剧集标志。

Both headphone models will be released in Japan on November 20th, with the collaboration model being sold in limited quantities by Sony's direct stores. 两款耳机将于 11 月 20 日在日本发售，联名款由索尼直营商店限量销售。

item.title: 蚂蚁上线 Ling-3.2-flash，模型可以看渲染结果再改代码
item.guid: 蚂蚁上线-Ling-3.2-flash，模型可以看渲染结果再改代码
item.description:
Ant Group's Bailin has opened up the multimodal model Ling-3.2-flash, originally used in Lingguang 2.0. It supports text, image, and video input, has a total of 560 billion parameters, activates 25 billion parameters per inference, and has a context window of 1 million Tokens. 蚂蚁百灵开放了原先用在灵光 2.0 里的多模态模型 Ling-3.2-flash。它支持文本、图像和视频输入，共有 5600 亿参数，每次推理激活 250 亿参数，上下文窗口为 100 万 Token。

When generating web pages or 3D scenes, the model can use the rendering result as the next input to check if the layout, geometry, and lighting deviate from requirements, and then adjust the code. If a tool call fails or a syntax error occurs, it can also read logs, attempt a retry, or adjust subsequent steps. 生成网页或三维场景时，模型可以把渲染结果作为下一轮输入，检查布局、几何结构和光影有没有偏离要求，再回头调整代码。遇到工具调用失败或语法错误时，它也可以读取日志，尝试重试或调整后续步骤。

Developers can experience it on the Bailin chat page or call it via APIs compatible with OpenAI or Anthropic protocols. 开发者可在百灵对话页体验，也可通过兼容 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 协议的 API 调用。

item.title: 开源工具 Poki 支持远程连接，让 AI 助手操作 iPhone 真机
item.guid: 开源工具-Poki-支持远程连接，让-AI-助手操作-iPhone-真机
item.description:
On November 6th, the open-source project Poki released v0.1.1, adding remote connectivity. Running on Mac, it can connect to MCP-supported clients like Codex and Claude Code, allowing assistants to read, tap, and swipe on iPhone screens. A standalone Poki Agent can also receive tasks from iMessage, Telegram, or the terminal. 11 月 6 日，开源项目 Poki 发布 v0.1.1，新增远程连接。它在 Mac 上运行，可接入 Codex、Claude Code 等支持 MCP 的客户端，让助手读取 iPhone 屏幕、点击和滑动。独立的 Poki Agent 还可以接收 iMessage、Telegram 或终端发来的任务。

Connecting to a physical device requires pairing the iPhone with a Mac via USB and installing a full Xcode on the Mac. The project currently only verifies physical device support under a Chinese interface, and physical device operations are limited to portrait mode. 连接真机需要先用 USB 将 iPhone 与 Mac 配对，并在 Mac 上安装完整的 Xcode。项目目前只在中文界面下验证过真机支持，真机操作限竖屏。

item.title: Meta 让 Muse 用户用一句话生成应用内工作区
item.guid: Meta-让-Muse-用户用一句话生成应用内工作区
item.description:
Meta has launched Spaces for its AI application Muse. Users describe the tools they want in a chat, and Muse generates a workspace that can be repeatedly opened, such as a holiday gift list, itinerary board, or music activity tracker. Meta 为 AI 应用 Muse 推出 Spaces。用户在聊天里描述自己想要的工具，Muse 会生成一个可以反复打开的工作区，例如节日礼物清单、行程板或音乐动态追踪器。

Users can continue to use conversations to change layouts or add features, and can also directly check items and add notes within the workspace. Workspaces can be pinned to the sidebar or main tab, and display times can be set, for example, showing weekly plans on weekdays and switching to weekend arrangements on Saturdays. 用户可以继续用对话改布局或加功能，也能直接在工作区里勾选事项、补记备注。工作区可固定在侧栏或主标签页，还能设定显示时间，例如工作日放周计划，周六换成周末安排。

After connecting external applications, workspaces can update information in the background. Meta gives an example: activities from school emails can be summarized on a Kanban board and then added to a calendar. Spaces has been launched in regions where Muse is available. 连接外部应用后，工作区可以在后台更新信息。Meta 举例说，学校邮件里的活动可以汇总到看板，再加进日历。Spaces 已在 Muse 可用的地区上线。

item.title: AI 短剧《持械入宋》走红，海外行业用「duanju」称呼微短剧
item.guid: AI-短剧《持械入宋》走红，海外行业用「duanju」称呼微短剧
item.description:
On November 6, the AI short drama "Armed into Song," which tells the story of five modern people traveling back to the Northern Song Dynasty, topped the Hongguo Short Drama AI recommendation list, with over 6.6 billion cumulative views across the entire network. It was produced by Lao Shiyi Theater, which started by taking AI short drama orders. Founder Zhang Hansheng began learning AI film and television production in March last year. 11 月 6 日，讲述五个现代人穿越北宋的 AI 短剧《持械入宋》登顶红果短剧 AI 推荐榜，全网累计播放量超过 66 亿次。它由从承接 AI 短剧订单起步的老十一剧场制作，创始人张汉生去年 3 月开始学习 AI 影视制作。

After its viral success, there were rumors circulating online that "the team invested 1 million in computing power and received over 10 million in returns." Zhang Hansheng directly denied this, saying: "Financially, it's definitely much better than before, but we haven't had time to calculate the profits yet." 爆火之后，网上流传着「团队投入算力 100 万、回报超千万」的说法。张汉生直接否认：「经济上肯定要比以前好很多，但目前还没来得及计算收益。」

Li Chaohua, the chief producer and chief screenwriter, introduced in an interview that the project is handled by 10 people. To avoid duplicate faces in group scenes, they created separate image assets for each character. Ordinary shots could be used after an average of three generations, while war scenes often required more than ten generations. 总制片兼总编剧李朝华在采访中介绍，项目由 10 人负责。为了避免群像戏里出现重复的人脸，他们给出场人物分别建立形象素材。普通镜头平均生成三次就能用，战争场面往往要生成十次以上。

Mini-dramas have also developed their own names overseas. According to a report by "People's Daily Overseas Edition," overseas practitioners are now using the Hanyu Pinyin "duanju" to refer to this type of series. 微短剧也在海外形成了自己的叫法。据《人民日报海外版》报道，海外从业者已用汉语拼音「duanju」称呼这类剧集。

In North America, Chinese mini-drama companies also collaborate with local teams for filming. Canadian actor Evan Bapty, for example, has appeared in Maple Interactive's "Return to the Peak." 在北美，中国微短剧公司也与当地团队合作拍摄，加拿大演员埃文·巴契奇就曾出演枫叶互动的《重返巅峰》。

item.title: 抖音双 11 进入冲刺期，豆包可领券、看直播下单
item.guid: 抖音双-11-进入冲刺期，豆包可领券、看直播下单
item.description:
Douyin Mall's Double 11 event entered the "Double 11 Carnival Day" phase on November 7, lasting until the 11th. Doubao also promoted the "Ask Doubao for Double 11" entry on its official public account, which is one of the channels through which Douyin E-commerce distributes consumer vouchers in batches during this major promotion. 抖音商城双 11 活动于 11 月 7 日进入「双 11 狂欢日」阶段，持续至 11 日。豆包也在官方公众号推广「双 11 问豆包」入口，这是抖音电商在本轮大促中分批发放消费券的渠道之一。

According to actual tests by "National Business Daily," users can submit shopping requests in Doubao, view product recommendations, and access coupon redemption. Some products receive Doubao channel subsidies in addition to Douyin Mall's full-reduction coupons. Recommendation cards can be embedded into live Douyin streams, allowing users to watch live broadcasts and place orders within Doubao. The shopping page will also aggregate Douyin e-commerce and lifestyle service orders. 据《每日经济新闻》实测，用户可在豆包里提出购物需求，查看商品推荐和领券入口。部分商品在抖音商城满减券之外还有豆包渠道补贴。推荐卡片可以嵌入正在开播的抖音直播间，用户可在豆包内看直播和下单，购物页还会汇总抖音电商及生活服务订单。

item.title: lululemon 首发 Ventscape 跑步马甲，12 月 8 日在中国上市
item.guid: lululemon-首发-Ventscape-跑步马甲，12-月-8-日在中国上市
item.description:
lululemon globally debuted its Ventscape running vest at the Shanghai CIIE on November 6. Designed for cold-weather running, it integrates an insulating layer and breathable mesh into the same vest, addressing the initial chill when starting a run and the stuffiness after accelerating, respectively. lululemon 于 11 月 6 日在上海进博会全球首发 Ventscape 跑步马甲。它面向冷天跑步，把保暖夹层和透气网眼做在同一件马甲上，分别应对刚起跑时的冷感和加速后的闷热。

The vest features PrimaLoft ThermoPlume+ insulation. According to the brand, the insulation helps retain heat when starting a run, and as pace increases, the ventilation structure introduces air to dissipate heat and moisture around the body. lululemon states that the R&D team simulated wind forces at different paces and used thermal mannequins to measure insulation performance. Lewis Hamilton and ultra-distance runner Leah Yingling also tested prototypes in low-temperature experimental chambers and actual running environments. 马甲采用 PrimaLoft ThermoPlume+ 保暖夹层。按品牌介绍，起跑时夹层有助于留住热量，配速提高后，通风结构可引入空气，排散身体周围的热量和湿气。lululemon 称，研发团队模拟了不同配速下的风力，并用热能人体模型测量保暖性能，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和超长距离跑者 Leah Yingling 也在低温实验舱及实际跑步环境中试穿过原型。

The vest will first be launched in China on December 8, available through lululemon stores and its official flagship store mini-program. 马甲将于 12 月 8 日在中国率先上市，通过 lululemon 门店和官方旗舰店小程序销售。

item.title: One Fun Thing｜用普通刻录机在光盘的数据面画图
item.guid: One-Fun-Thing｜用普通刻录机在光盘的数据面画图
item.description:
The open-source tool Disc Image Studio can turn photos or illustrations into disc data, which can then be written onto blank CDs, DVDs, or single-layer BD-Rs using an ordinary burner. The written data area will display a visible pattern under light. 开源工具 Disc Image Studio 可以把照片或插画变成一段光盘数据，用普通刻录机写入空白 CD、DVD 或单层 BD-R。写入后的数据区在光线下会显出肉眼可见的图案。

The software allows importing images, overlaying layers, and then adjusting dithering, brightness, and grayscale. The track pitch of the disc affects the shape of the pattern, and the software allows calibration based on a photo of the disc surface to reduce instances of straight lines appearing curved. The Windows desktop version can export images and also offers experimental instant burning. macOS and Linux have experimental command-line tools that can generate images for other burning software to write. 软件可以导入图片、叠加图层，再调抖动、亮度和灰阶。盘片的轨距会影响图案的形状，软件允许根据盘面照片做标定，减轻直线刻出来弯曲的情况。Windows 桌面版可导出镜像，也提供实验性即时刻录。macOS 和 Linux 有实验性命令行工具，可生成供其他刻录软件写入的镜像。

item.title: 周末看什么｜《假如爱有如果》
item.guid: 周末看什么｜《假如爱有如果》
item.description:
After the worker Haoxi lost his job, a documentary director wanted to film his life with his wife Meiyu. Meiyu and the director gradually became friends, and the two couples began to socialize. The filming brought these people together, yet they found it difficult to discuss work, money, and marriage in the same way. 工人浩锡失业后，一名纪录片导演想拍下他和妻子美玉的生活。美玉与导演逐渐成了朋友，两对夫妻开始来往。拍摄让这几个人坐到了一起，他们却很难用同一种方式谈论工作、钱和婚姻。

"Possible Love," directed by Lee Chang-dong, is his first feature film in eight years since "Burning." Sol Kyung-gu and Jeon Do-yeon play the worker couple, Jo Yeo-jeong plays the documentary director, and Jo In-sung plays her husband. Lee Chang-dong told The Associated Press in an interview that the inspiration came from the Ssangyong Motor layoffs in South Korea. He and screenwriter Oh Jung-mi also wrote filmmakers attempting to document the workers' plight into the story. 《假如爱有如果》（Possible Love）由李沧东执导，是他继《燃烧》后时隔八年推出的剧情长片。薛景求、全度妍饰演工人夫妇，曹汝贞饰演纪录片导演，赵寅成饰演她的丈夫。李沧东在接受美联社采访时说，创作灵感来自韩国双龙汽车的裁员事件。他与编剧吴政美把试图记录工人处境的电影人也写进了故事。

The film won the Grand Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival and was released on Netflix on November 6. All 80 reviews collected by Rotten Tomatoes were positive. A review in the British Film Institute's "Sight & Sound" noted that the film incorporated labor relations into small actions, such as an unemployed worker having to recite work slogans in front of a foreman after finding a new job. 影片获威尼斯电影节评审团大奖，11 月 6 日已上线 Netflix。烂番茄收录的 80 篇影评均为好评。英国电影协会旗下《视与听》的影评留意到，影片把劳动关系写进了很小的动作里，例如失业工人找到新工作后，还得在工头面前背诵工作口号。

item.title: 买书不读指南｜《世界诞生之日》
item.guid: 买书不读指南｜《世界诞生之日》
item.description:
The girl in "The Dispossessed" grew up living on a generational starship. She knew the destination was a planet but found it hard to imagine air staying put in a place without walls. Ursula K. Le Guin started with this question, allowing people born on a starship to try and understand what "outdoors" means. 《失落天堂》里的女孩从小住在世代航行的飞船上。她知道目的地是一颗行星，却很难想象空气可以在没有墙壁的地方留住。厄休拉·勒古恩从这个疑问写起，让一艘飞船里出生的人试着理解什么是户外。

This novella is included in the short story collection "The Birthday of the World." The opening story, "The Coming of Age in Karhide," returns to Gethen from "The Left Hand of Darkness," changing the narrator to a local resident who recounts her coming-of-age ceremony. "The Seggri Affair," on the other hand, uses records from different periods to piece together the social life of another planet: where the number of men is far fewer than women, they live in castles, and life revolves around athletic competitions. 这篇小说收在短篇集《世界诞生之日》里。开篇的《卡亥德的成年礼》回到《黑暗的左手》中的格森星，把讲故事的人换成一位当地居民，由她回忆自己的成年礼。《塞格里纪事》则用不同时期的记录，拼出另一个星球的社会生活：那里的男性人数远少于女性，住在城堡里，生活围着运动竞赛打转。

The book collects 8 novellas. The simplified Chinese edition, translated by Maya, was published in October by Beijing United Publishing Company. 全书收录 8 篇小说。马雅翻译的简体中文版已于 10 月由北京联合出版公司出版。

item.title: 游戏推荐｜《Otter Cafe》在桌面一角开家水獭咖啡厅
item.guid: 游戏推荐｜《Otter-Cafe》在桌面一角开家水獭咖啡厅
item.description:
"Otter Cafe" opens a small coffee shop on your Windows desktop. Animal customers seat themselves, an otter chef prepares meals, and servers bring them to the tables. The shop starts with a few small tables, and players gradually collect recipes, regular customers, and furniture. They can also change the servers' outfits and redecorate the counter. 《Otter Cafe》会在 Windows 桌面上开一间小咖啡厅。动物客人自行入座，水獭主厨做餐，服务生端到桌上。店从几张小桌子开起，玩家陆续收集食谱、常客和家具，也能给服务生换衣服，重新布置吧台。

The small shop can be moved to the edge of the screen, and animals can be thrown to another screen. In the shop, you will encounter leopard cats, Taiwanese pangolins, and sika deer, and you can also unlock bubble tea. The game has built-in sticky notes, a calculator, and a pigeon Pomodoro timer, allowing you to continue handling other desktop tasks while the cafe is open. 小店可以挪到屏幕边上，动物还可以被抛到另一块屏幕。店里会遇到石虎、台湾穿山甲和梅花鹿，也能解锁珍珠奶茶。游戏内置便利贴、计算器和鸽子番茄钟，咖啡厅营业时可以继续处理桌面上的其他事情。

The game was developed and published by the independent team Toro Studio, released on Steam on November 3rd, and supports Simplified Chinese. 游戏由独立团队 Toro Studio 开发并发行，11 月 3 日在 Steam 发售，支持简体中文。

AI 智能体 iPhone Duo MacBook Pro OpenAI 特斯拉 Tesla
